## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is Laravel-specific and does not duplicate `pharaonic/php-readable` core behavior.
- [ ] Existing outputs are unchanged, or the change fixes a wrong value and is covered in `tests/Unit/LegacyFixesTest.php`.
- [ ] Tests were added or updated.
- [ ] `composer check` passes.
- [ ] Documentation was updated when the public API changed.
